template.summary: The 2-party property file e2e/tests/multi-user.property.spec.ts (1111 LOC) is the structural template. ModelState (lines 75-132), RealSystem (138-214), 14 command classes (231-861), 5 assertion functions (862-985), fc.assert wiring with numRuns:20/maxCommands:10 (1025-1111). All DSL helpers re-exportable from e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts.

command_classes.Cg: no args; only fires once; A creates group
command_classes.In: no args; A invites B (B fixed)
command_classes.Lg: actor: ActorId; per-actor leave; embeds A14 wire check when last leaf
command_classes.Fd: no args; A forgets B's leaf-by-index; embeds A14 + A10 polling
command_classes.Rd: no args; A renames first device-row
command_classes.Ct/Ut/Sc/As/Un/Dt: actor + payload; dispatch on r.page(actor); embed A1-A5 inline expects
command_classes.Rl: actor: ActorId; reloads page + asserts pre-reload tasks preserved (A11)
command_classes.Sw: no args; switches A's context to bunker B; clears m.memberA/groupIdA/epochSequenceA

assertions.assertC0: tasks + members + epoch + per-pubkey leaf counts equal across A and B; skip if !memberA||!memberB
assertions.assertS5: biconditional p ∈ members ⇔ leafCount>=1 for pubkeyA + pubkeyB; scoped to groupIdA
assertions.assertS7: post-Sw, no priorGroupIds in switched context

fc_wiring.per_run_reset: new ModelState() seeded with cachedPubkeyA/B (no browser re-auth); switchIdentity restore only if pubkeyA drifted

welcome_and_multi_device.summary: Two contexts on the same bunker only produce distinct MLS leaves if pinClientSlot is given an explicit slot string. The canonical leaf-join wait pattern is expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(primaryPage, groupId, pubkey), {timeout:30000}).toHaveLength(2), already used in forget-device-sibling.spec.ts:136-138. data-testid='device-row' lives in src/components/DeviceList.tsx:210 (one li per leaf of LOCAL identity only).

critical_constraints.slot_pinning: authenticate(page, E2E_BUNKER_URL, 'A1') and authenticate(page, E2E_BUNKER_URL, 'A2') — explicit slot mandatory; without it both contexts derive the same slot from the bunker pubkey and only one KP lands on the relay
critical_constraints.auth_order: B authenticates before A; KP must be on the relay before A invites. For lazy A2 auth via AttachA2Command_MD, the welcome wait absorbs the post-CgCommand_MD KP-publish delay
critical_constraints.pubkey_hex_gate: getPubkeyHex requires window.__notestrTestPubkey hook, installed only after MarmotProvider auth completes (client.tsx:417-620). Do not call on pageA2 before authenticate() finishes its hook poll. Spec uses cachedPubkeyA from A1 instead — correct.
critical_constraints.init_script_timing: pinClientSlot uses page.addInitScript() and must precede the first page.goto. authenticate handles this; do not pre-goto pageA2 in beforeAll.
critical_constraints.device_row_scope: device-row count on a given page reflects the local identity's leaves only. On pageA1/pageA2 it shows pubkeyA's leaves; on pageB it shows pubkeyB's leaves.
critical_constraints.indexeddb_isolation: Each browser.newContext() gets its own IndexedDB. No cross-context state sharing.
